backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko canister actor with no functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing an update to brandAssets.ts and listing related components and tests.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing pre-generated summaries of various frontend files.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide outlining build checks, common issues, and required configurations for production deployment.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind base file defining extensive OKLCH color variables for light and dark mode themes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell that loads the React app via main.tsx into a root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component composing the header, hero, about, services, contact sections, and footer.
frontend/src/components/ContactForm.tsx: Client-side validated contact form with input handling, inline errors, and simulated submission feedback.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: About section showing mission text and three core values with icons in a three-column layout.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Renders a contact section with email, address, phone info, and a contact form, including phone sanitization for tel links.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Displays the hero banner with background image, headline text, and CTA buttons that smoothly scroll to page sections.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Shows a grid of service cards using icon mappings and marketing copy for titles and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer with brand text, navigation links, social icons, and a bottom bar with attribution.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Sticky responsive header with logo, navigation, mobile menu, and smooth-scroll behavior.
frontend/src/content/brandAssets.ts: Defines centralized file paths for large and standard logo assets.
frontend/src/content/marketingCopy.ts: Exports static marketing content for hero, about, services, and contact sections.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on identity state and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity login state, identity management, and auth-client initialization via React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file prepared for future backend queries using the actor system.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles and defines light and dark theme CSS variables for the app.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, fonts, animations, and enabling plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
frontend/tsconfig.node.json: TypeScript config for Vite's Node environment with ESNext modules and composite builds.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite config enabling React, path aliasing for src, build output settings, and dev server port.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing logo replacement tasks, required images, and pending feature requests.
